description: For a website that sends shop events, over the analysis window: totals (visits, adds to cart, checkouts, purchases, revenue), the items earning most (viewed, added, checked out, bought, revenue) and the landing pages earning most. Says when the site sells nothing. Another organization's or an unconnected site answers not found. Read-only.
